hypothesis: With the released StarWAM no-feature-timestep architecture and its 1000-step linear warmup plus cosine schedule, RMS-matching cached H3 features at scale 0.009606920816877307 remains finite and stable across two optimizer steps and is more stable than raw scale 1 under an otherwise identical run.
single_variable: feature_input_scale: 1.0 versus 0.009606920816877307; no timestep token, warmup schedule, source, model, samples and random seeds are identical.
parent_baseline: Exact paired raw scale=1 arm in this experiment. The preceding timestep-token/no-warmup diagnostic was NO_GO: raw loss ratio 1858.83 and RMS-match ratio 658.71 despite exact restore.

references.title: Fast-WAM: Can Video Generation Models Act as World-Action Models?
fastwam_deploy standalone INT8-H3 StarWAM trainer
references.revision: dab8058 plus isolated R1 schema2 scheduler/scale diff

architecture.paper: World-model observations condition an independent action transformer.
architecture.upstream_code: Pinned ActionDiT/WanBlock; released LIBERO YAML sets feature_condition_include_timestep=false.
architecture.local: Byte-pinned ActionDiT and include_feature_timestep=false; standalone frozen INT8-H3 replaces online Wan2.2.
architecture.rationale: Action carrier and no-timestep interface are exact; the explicit experiment is the H3 backbone port.

data.field: paired windows and fixed scale audit
data.upstream_code: 32 actions and observation features pooled to 32 tokens.
data.local: Both arms use the same four unique v8 manifest windows; the scale was fixed from the first 512 feature samples and all 40 task contexts before execution.
data.rationale: Pairing isolates feature magnitude while preserving the released action/token spans.

action.upstream_code: 7D x32 actions and 8D proprio, min/max to [-1,1] and clip [-5,5].
action.local: Same dimensions, normalization and pad masking in both arms.

objective.paper: Continuous flow matching for action generation.
objective.upstream_code: Shift-5 scheduler and timestep-weighted masked MSE.
objective.local: Direct imports of pinned scheduler and loss with shift5.

optimization.upstream_code: AdamW 1e-4, WD0.01, betas(0.9,0.95), clip1, BF16, warmup1000 then cosine to base-LR*0.01.
optimization.local: Exact optimizer/schedule parameters, including initial effective LR1e-7 and strict scheduler checkpoint state; depth2/two-step budget only diagnoses stability.
optimization.rationale: Schedule is aligned; the bounded depth and steps are intentionally not a convergence run.

evaluation.paper: Closed-loop LIBERO success is the endpoint.
evaluation.local: Scaled arm requires fresh restore max_abs=0; finite/nonzero three-path gradients and head update; step2/step1 loss<=2, prediction_std<=2, expert gradient<=10 and projector gradient<=10. Raw arm uses the same measurements.
evaluation.rationale: This gate establishes numerical trainability only and makes no policy-quality claim.

evidence: Pinned commit and enforced ActionDiT/WanBlock hashes
ModelSpec records include_feature_timestep=false and feature scale
Strict cache metadata and fixed manifest/stats hashes
Warmup/cosine unit test, schema2 scheduler save/restore test and per-step LR logging
Numeric stability thresholds fixed before launch
14 focused local tests pass including ActionDiT/projector gradients
scaled loss 1.359375 -> 1.1796875; prediction_std 1.43758 -> 1.47292; all logged gradients finite/nonzero
both schema2 checkpoints fresh-process restore max_abs=0.0 at completed_steps=2
exact raw arm loss 4000 -> 4992 versus scaled 1.359375 -> 1.1796875
RMS scale reduces first-step loss 2942x, prediction std 66x, expert gradient 6567x under exact pairing

decision.rationale: The paired gate passed every threshold and schema2 restore. Authorize only one full30 optimizer step with RMS-match scale followed by fresh-process restore; no multi-step or long training is authorized.
decision.launch_command: PROJECT_ROOT=/mnt/h3-wam/r1-action-canary/project NPROC_PER_NODE=2 bash scripts/h3wam/launch_h3_int8_starwam_action.sh MANIFEST --cache-root CACHE --output FULL30_TRAIN.json --save-checkpoint FULL30.pt --steps 1 --limit 16 --action-layers 30 --feature-input-scale 0.009606920816877307 --warmup-steps 1000 --scheduler-horizon 21700 --min-learning-rate 1e-6, then a fresh NPROC_PER_NODE=1 --restore-check-only with the identical contract.

production_depth_gate: PASS: all outputs/three-path gradients are finite, the ActionDiT head update is nonzero, peak_reserved_gib < 80, and fresh-process restore max_abs=0.0.

production_depth_result.scope: Mechanical trainability only. No full30 multi-step stability, held-out action metric or closed-loop policy quality is established.
